options.content:
## ⚓ Midnight Rider — Data Model Status
_Référence complète : 12 instruments, 50+ mesures. **🟢 ACTIVE** = < 30s. **🟠 STALE** = > 30s. **🔴 NO DATA** = non connecté. **⬡ Résumé** = pire cas._

panels.title: ⬡ Résumé
panels.description: Pire cas — rouge si un capteur hors ligne

targets.query:
from(bucket:"midnight_rider")
 |> range(start: -5m)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.speedOverGround" or r._measurement == "environment.system.cpuTemperature")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field != "lat" and r._field != "lon")
 |> group()
 |> last()
 |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time) < 30000000000 then 1.0 else 0.5}))
 |> min()

 |> range(start: -5m)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment.system.cpuTemperature" or r._measurement == "environment.system.cpuUsage" or r._measurement == "environment.system.memoryUsed")

 |> group()
 |> last()
